qualifications: Gap counts are category/year research opportunities, not distinct states or missing required annual censuses.
The political denominator counts distinct provisionally eligible raw map IDs; unresolved classifications and mapping reviews are separate fields.
Statistics require explicit observed-year evidence for coverage; nearby dated evidence does not fill a year and is not interpolated.
Field coverage measures source-backed category/year records, not historical truth or exhaustive institutions; contextual events and figures need relevant evidence, not a complete annual census.
Source quality flags concern missing/broken provenance and explicitly uncertain confidence, not automatic institutional ranking.
Editorial existence envelopes and shared map geometry do not establish historical lifetime, sovereignty or succession.
Queued, researched and accepted production coverage are separate states; job completion does not itself change production.
